monsters.name: orc priest
monsters.description:
A servant of Beogh, the ancient god of the orcs. Beogh rewards its devoted prayers by striking down its enemies.

Max HP: ~15      Will: +          AC: +          EV: ++                         
Threat: High    Class: Natural  Size: Medium    Int: Human      


You have about 61% to hit with your +0 hand axe and 50% to hit with your headbutt.
It has about 51% to hit you.

Attack        Max Damage  
Hit: +0 mace  10          

It has a 100% chance to notice you each turn.
It can open doors.
To read a description, press the key listed above. (AdB) indicates damage (the sum of A B-sided dice), (x%) indicates the chance to defeat your Will, and (y) indicates the spell range; shown in red if you are in range.

Cantrip: 
Pain: (76%,1d9)
Smiting: 7-17
Heal Other:
